notes.title: Solar System Update
notes.notes:
A new Globesweeper patch is available which includes Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune skins along with an update to the Venus and Moon skins.

To celebrate Globesweeper has 50% off this week!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing moon skin to not show neighbours upon double click
[*]Updated Venus skin to show the clouds of Venus when hidden
[*]Improved Mars skin
[*]Added Mercury skin
[*]Added Jupiter skin
[*]Added Saturn skin
[*]Added Uranus skin
[*]Added Neptune skin
[*]Removed twitch requirement for skin
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.5.2
notes.notes: Just a small update to fix zoom bindings, and added an option to disable mouse scroll all together.

notes.title: Update 1.5.1
notes.notes:
Small patch mainly addressing some of the issues with the new patch and the Linux version.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[*]Added in game resolution settings

[/olist]

notes.title: Globesweeper v1.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.5.0 is now available for Globesweeper which has some great performance optimisations along with some quality of life improvements.

It is also the 1 year anniversary of Globesweeper so to celebrate Globesweeper and Globesweeper: Hex Puzzler will be on sale from the 17th to the 23rd.

There is a new discord for Globesweeper. Come join us at: https://discord.gg/TySxyCj

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3][list]
[*] Added key binding into in game options
[*] Removed game Launcher
[*] Greatly improved game loading
[*] New splash menu
[/list]

notes.title: Globesweeper QoL Update
notes.notes:
This update addresses a lot of the great feedback that has been posted on the Globesweeper discussions along with a crazy new theme based on a fractal mandelbulb design. See the patch notes below for all the details.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376047/b625ac6783c56de9faa25e654dbae8aaaab30296.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added - Mandelbulb theme
[*] Added - Option to remove "?" feature
[*] Added - Configuration menu
[*] Added - Option to reverse keyboard movement controls
[*] Added - New explosion sound effects
[*] Changed - Main music theme volume decreased
[*] Changed - Game now defaults to full screen on first launch
[/list]
